line.name: H. Upmann Nicaragua AJ Fernandez Heritage
line.description: Not on the site. Debuted January 2022 at TPE (Tobacco Plus Expo). A collaboration between A.J. Fernandez and Rafael Nodal, distinct from the earlier (2017) 'H. Upmann by AJ Fernandez' line researched separately in this batch - different wrapper (Brazilian vs. Ecuadorian), positioned as a heritage/legacy-style release. Medium to medium-full strength; notes of earthiness, spice, sweetness.
line.factory: Tabacalera A.J. Fernandez Cigars de Nicaragua, Esteli, Nicaragua
